acl_permit.note: RouterOS's default forward policy is accept, so a zone stays reachable without an explicit permit rule; adding one would only shadow that default. The deny rules are what change behaviour, and they are ordered first because RouterOS evaluates the forward chain in rule order.

acl_apply.note: RouterOS filter rules take effect globally on the forward chain as soon as they are added; there is no per-interface apply step like IOS `ip access-group`. The rule added by acl_deny is already in force, so there is nothing further to emit.
